protocol_deviations: Deterministic placeholder handlers for solve/prove in src/tikhon/cli.py _deterministic_handlers are intentionally NOT added: cli.py is owned by a concurrent agent this wave, and the issue scopes this pass to contracts only. CLI dispatch integration for these adapters lands in a later pass; a program dispatching solve/prove will fail at runtime dispatch (unknown handler) until then, though it already lints and validates.

The installed `tikhon` CLI binary resolves to a stale non-editable site-packages copy while pytest uses the repo src (pyproject pythonpath). Lint/seal were run with the installed CLI as mandated; since the sealed program uses only long-registered commands, the digest was additionally re-verified with the repo parser (PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tikhon seal) and matches seal.txt byte-for-byte. The stale install was left untouched per file-constraint rules.

solve/prove are placed at the end of BUILTIN_FACTORIES (registration order is irrelevant because Registry.names() sorts), and the FORMALIZATION enum member is inserted before UNKNOWN rather than appended, grouping it with the semantic failure kinds; neither choice affects any digest or serialized output beyond the intended additions.
